verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's own CLI `init` writes per-harness skill files for exactly two agents, Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills). A hands-on dry run confirmed both targets. Other agents can only connect through a generic remote MCP URL, not a per-harness install. Missing for 10: Cursor and other harness targets for per-harness instruction install, documented per-harness differences beyond file location, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
the dry run previews both harness targets (Codex .agents/skills and Claude Code .claude/skills) without writing anything.
In your agent host's remote MCP settings, add a connection with this server URL: https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp
